change: rekolekt #85: captions overshadowed by a native transcript are flagged (triggers keep the flag current) and left out of new partial caption full-text indexes; unfiltered relevance searches for very common words rank only the newest broadcasts' matches
schema_revision: 20261107_caption_overshadowed (applied by this rollout; rewrites about 7.7M youtube_segments rows and runs VACUUM FULL youtube_segments)
pre_deploy_smoke: on Almaz: API image imports app.main, ships the 20261107 migration, COMMON_QUERY_MATCHES=20000 and the overshadowed caption filter

database_settings_20261107.reason: JIT compilation took 2.3 s of a 3.5 s search for a common word
database_settings_20261107.applied: ALTER SYSTEM SET jit = off; pg_reload_conf() (no restart), 2026-11-07
database_settings_20261107.rollback: ALTER SYSTEM RESET jit; SELECT pg_reload_conf()

migration_attempts.started: about 02:01 UTC, 2026-11-07, with the API and background jobs still running
migration_attempts.result: deadlock about 30 s in: the migration held youtube_transcripts and waited on youtube_segments while a live search held the reverse; PostgreSQL cancelled the migration and the transaction rolled back, leaving the schema at 20261106_segment_words
migration_attempts.noticed: about two hours later; the waiter looked for an end-of-run line that the failed run never wrote

migration_attempts.started: 04:02 UTC after stopping api, summary-refresher, archive-intelligence-refresher, archive-enrichment-queue, analytics-retention and worker
migration_attempts.result: succeeded at about 04:21 UTC; services restarted, site down from about 04:03 to 04:23 UTC

lesson: Stop every database client before a migration that alters more than one search table, and wait on the migrations container's exit code rather than a log line.
